mapper.select: SELECT * FROM xsy_payment_refund_recovery_log WHERE refund_id = #{refundId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT r.id FROM xsy_payment_refund r LEFT JOIN xsy_refund_funding_allocation a ON r.source_type = 'REFUND_FUNDING_ALLOCATION' AND a.id = r.source_id AND a.deleted = FALSE WHERE r.deleted = FALSE AND r.next_recovery_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND (r.recovery_lease_until IS NULL OR r.recovery_lease_until < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND (r.status IN ('CREATED', 'PROCESSING') OR (r.status = 'SUCCEEDED' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM xsy_finance_payment p WHERE p.source_type = 'ORDER_REFUND' AND p.entry_type = 'NORMAL' AND p.deleted = FALSE AND p.source_id = CASE WHEN r.source_type = 'ORDER_REFUND' THEN r.source_id ELSE a.order_refund_id END))) ORDER BY r.next_recovery_at, r.id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE xsy_payment_refund SET recovery_lease_until = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '10 minutes', recovery_attempts = recovery_attempts + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE AND status IN ('CREATED', 'PROCESSING', 'SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED') AND (recovery_lease_until IS NULL OR recovery_lease_until < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND (#{force} OR next_recovery_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO xsy_payment_refund_recovery_log (refund_id, operator, reason, result, provider_amount, detail) VALUES (#{id}, #{operator}, #{reason}, #{result}, #{amount}, #{detail})
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCEEDED' THEN provider_amount ELSE amount END), 0) FROM xsy_payment_refund WHERE transaction_id = #{transactionId} AND deleted = FALSE AND status IN ('CREATED', 'PROCESSING', 'SUCCEEDED')
SELECT * FROM xsy_payment_refund WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM xsy_payment_refund WHERE refund_no = #{refundNo} AND deleted = FALSE
SELECT * FROM xsy_payment_refund WHERE source_type = #{sourceType} AND source_id = #{sourceId} AND deleted = FALSE ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(provider_amount), 0) FROM xsy_payment_refund WHERE transaction_id = #{transactionId} AND status = 'SUCCEEDED' AND deleted = FALSE
mapper.update: UPDATE xsy_payment_refund SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', provider_refund_no = #{providerRefundNo}, provider_amount = #{providerAmount}, refunded_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, failure_code = NULL, failure_message = NULL, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{operator} WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('CREATED', 'PROCESSING') AND deleted = FALSE

UPDATE xsy_payment_refund SET status = 'CREATED', provider_refund_no = NULL, provider_amount = NULL, refunded_at = NULL, failure_code = NULL, failure_message = NULL, mock_scenario = #{mockScenario}, next_recovery_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, recovery_status = NULL, recovery_message = NULL, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{operator} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'FAILED' AND deleted = FALSE
